characters.description: The characters this chapter shows something new about. Only ids from the list of characters.

id.description: The character id exactly as given.

text.description: One visual detail in a short statement, with the author's words in quotation marks where they carry the image.

lasting.description: False for a detail of this scene alone, such as a disguise, a costume or an injury that will heal.

appearance.description: Empty for the everyday look. For a detail of a second appearance the story returns to, such as Class armour or another body, its kebab-case slug, e.g. overlord-armor.

quote.description: The passage of this chapter that shows the detail, copied word for word: one to three sentences, with nothing left out and nothing changed.

new_settings.description: Places where a scene of this chapter happens that the list of settings does not have.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug of the name, e.g. the-gilded-anchor. Never reuse an existing id.

name.description: The place's name as the story most often uses it, or a short descriptive name when it has none.

aliases.description: Every other way the text refers to the place.

description.description: One sentence: what the place is.

text.description: One visual detail in a short statement, with the author's words in quotation marks where they carry the image.

lasting.description: False for a detail of this scene alone, such as the weather of one day.

quote.description: The passage of this chapter that shows the detail, copied word for word: one to three sentences, with nothing left out and nothing changed.

evidence.description: A short quote from the chapter that puts a scene in this place.

settings.description: Every known setting where a scene of this chapter happens, with what the chapter adds to its look.

id.description: The setting id exactly as given.
